summary: PR #307's teardown source regression proves that start/get/stop/restart call assertStudioServer(), but it never binds the assertStudioServer helper body to both RunService:IsStudio() and RunService:IsServer(). A future helper weakening/no-op could therefore leave every teardown-order assertion green while silently weakening the Studio/server authority fence. Current production helper is correct; the finding applies to the successor/replay test contract, not current runtime behavior.
evidence: PR #307 exact head c9760f2ca1048cf5ea3049e1690642821f216214 slices start/stop/restart and checks ordered assertStudioServer() call text, but does not inspect the helper implementation itself.
Current main src/server/PhysicsLab/PhysicsLabStudioHarness.luau defines assertStudioServer() with both exact RunService:IsStudio() and RunService:IsServer() assertions.
The successor salvage after PR #348 should preserve teardown-order coverage and additionally regression-lock both helper assertions before treating assertStudioServer() calls as authority evidence.
No Roblox Studio or real two-client execution is claimed by this source-only finding.
